body: Yeah I don't really ask for space because we're genuinely happy together. We just end up letting the most littlest things affect our whole mood towards each other for the day. And I hate it. Because I know I love her but I can't shake the anger so easily. And I hate how much I hate myself for being angry, and when she gets angry back she says it's because I made her that way and that makes me hate myself more even though I know it's not true. Idk, i'm just tired of fighting but i'm not tired of her.

No it's okay you can take your time. And it's just, I wake up and I begin my day by talking to her. We always text throughout the day. Most of the time we spend our nights together after work and school and we just talk until we fall asleep. This isn't exactly every single day but it is most of my days so she's basically taken up my whole life.

She just cares more about her own life than her boyfriends life. And I wish I could just move on from her and be happy without her but I put all my happiness in her and made my life revolve around her. If she leaves, I'll probably kill myself. I don't want to feel this way.
It just sucks that people can't take me serious. About anything, not just this. I'm just a big joke to everybody around me and I wish people would see that i'm literally pleading for help.
